# 1. Executive Summary and Objectives

## 1.1 Testing Purpose

Testing is essential for the WIN App transformation project to validate that the migration from Microsoft PowerApps to a native Flutter-based mobile application delivers a reliable, performant, and user-centric experience for Hilti Account Managers. Given the critical nature of this application—supporting daily sales workflows, AI-powered voice interactions, and real-time CRM synchronization—comprehensive testing will ensure zero data loss during Salesforce sync operations, validate AI transcription and summarization accuracy, confirm offline/online resilience, and verify enterprise security standards compliance. Testing will de-risk the production deployment by identifying defects early, validating integrations across Azure AI, OpenAI Whisper, Salesforce, and AWS backend services, and ensuring the application meets the stringent KPIs defined for user adoption, productivity, and technical performance.

## 1.2 Project Overview

The WIN App is a strategic transformation of Hilti's existing PowerApps-based sales assistant into a native Flutter mobile application distributed via Microsoft Intune to managed devices. The application supports Account Managers through five planning journey steps: Prioritize Customers, Schedule Meetings, Prepare Next Meeting, Support During Meeting, and Follow-Up on Meeting. Key capabilities include AI-powered voice recording and transcription (OpenAI Whisper), automated summary generation (Azure AI), conversational chatbot support, automated Salesforce CRM updates, offline data capture with secure background synchronization, and a customizable smart dashboard. The initial release targets Android devices with subsequent iOS availability.

## 1.4 Success Criteria

Testing will be deemed successful when: all 22 functional requirements pass acceptance criteria; zero Critical and zero High severity defects remain open at UAT exit; performance benchmarks are met across all supported device configurations; offline synchronization achieves 99%+ success rate; Salesforce data integrity is validated with zero corruption incidents; and business stakeholders provide formal sign-off on UAT completion.

## 3.2 Test Types and Approach

### 3.2.1 Functional Testing

Positive Scenarios: Validate all happy-path workflows including complete follow-up creation (record → transcribe → summarize → validate → save to Salesforce), successful SSO login, chatbot Q&A sessions, My Day calendar navigation, and manual record creation with all mandatory fields populated.

Negative Scenarios: Invalid credentials, empty form submissions, network disconnection mid-operation, AI service timeout, Salesforce API errors, exceeding 2,000-character chatbot limit, audio recording deletion confirmation, and navigation-back with unsaved changes.

Boundary Conditions: Chatbot input at exactly 2,000 characters, audio recording at 0 seconds and maximum duration, date boundaries for calendar navigation, mandatory field minimum/maximum lengths, and concurrent event display limits.

### 3.2.2 Integration Testing

- Salesforce API: CRUD operations for Events, Leads, Contacts; data integrity validation; proxy service routing; error response handling; token refresh scenarios
- Azure AI/OpenAI Whisper: Audio upload, transcription accuracy, summary generation, language parameter handling, timeout and retry behavior
- Azure SSO: Token acquisition, refresh, expiration, MFA flow, invalid token handling
- Intune MDM: App deployment, policy enforcement, managed device validation
- AWS Backend: Data synchronization, session management, preference storage

### 3.2.3 System Testing

End-to-end business process validation covering the complete AM planning journey:

- Login → Home Screen → My Day → Select Event → Meeting Prep → Attend Meeting → Follow-Up Recording → AI Summary → Generate Items → Save to Salesforce
- Adhoc Follow-Up: Quick Action → Auto-Record → Stop → Summary → Save
- Offline Workflow: Record offline → Reconnect → Sync → Verify in Salesforce

### 3.2.4 User Acceptance Testing

Business scenario validation with actual Account Managers executing real-world workflows. Focus areas: daily workflow efficiency, AI summary quality assessment, CRM data accuracy, and usability rating collection. UAT will be conducted in a production-like environment with representative Salesforce data.

Automated regression suite executed on every build via GitLab CI/CD pipeline. Suite covers all Critical (P1) and High (P2) scenarios. Full regression cycle duration target: ≤ 4 hours. Triggered automatically on merge to main branch and manually before each release candidate.
